# GET /api/v1/orgs/{org}/activities/feeds

List an organization's activity feeds

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** optional (public access allowed, private feeds require membership) · **ID:** `ep-035`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| org | path | string | True |
| date | query | string | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

| Activity feeds include private actions only if user is admin or org member | authorization | ctx.IsSigned && (ctx.Doer.IsAdmin || org.IsOrgMember(ctx, ctx.Doer.ID)) |

### Error Paths

- **org not found** → orgAssignment middleware → 404
- **IsOrgMember fails** → ListOrgActivityFeeds → 500
- **GetFeeds fails** → ListOrgActivityFeeds → 500
